source.note: A curated colour is an EDITORIAL association, not a measurement, and is recorded as such: `confidence: editorial` on every token this file produces. The hue is the one Indian election graphics and the parties' own flags and symbols have long used — saffron for the BJP, sky blue for the Congress, red for the communist parties, green for the Trinamool and the Dravidian parties. No party publishes a hex value, so none is quoted as though it had. Lightness and chroma are NOT the association: they are chosen inside a measured band so the colour is legible on this product's surfaces, and so that parties sharing a hue family separate on the axis a dichromat keeps.

band.note: The range curated lightnesses sit in. It documents intent; the FLOORS are what is enforced, by viz/party-ink.test.ts: every fill clears 3:1 against all three surfaces, and one of the two inks clears 4.5:1 on top of it. Around the crossover where neither ink clears, no lightness is legal at all — which is why two of these values are not round numbers. Phase 3's additions were placed by ops/geo/tune-lightness.mjs, which holds each party's HUE fixed — the hue is the association — and picks the legal lightness that best separates it from the parties it actually appears beside.

derived.note: Three lightnesses, each legal for EVERY hue: 0.54-0.58 is a dead band where the light ink has stopped clearing 4.5:1 and the dark ink has not started, so no generated colour may land there. The chroma was 0.055 until Phase 3 put constituency maps on the screen and showed what that meant — Karnataka's third party won 23 seats and its polygons read as unshaded. The real fix was to CURATE the parties that carry states, which this file now does for sixty; the chroma moved with it, as far as it can go while the two registers still separate by the margin viz/party-ink.test.ts enforces. A generated colour is a party's colour and a quieter one; it is no longer close to absence. Five lightnesses rather than three, for a reason Phase 3 measured: at this chroma sRGB cannot distinguish 3,600 hues — a low-chroma sweep rounds to about 350 distinct triples per lightness — so the register held about a thousand colours and two one-seat parties in Maharashtra 2019 collided. More lightnesses is the only axis available, since raising chroma would put the quiet register inside the curated band.

YSRCP.name: YSR Congress Party

BJD.note: green-teal, from the party's flag, shifted off the Trinamool's green

IND.name: Independent
